source.title: Year End Message 2019
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We had another successful year of cubing and developing the WCA as an organization in 2019! We would like to take this moment to share the highlights of what we have accomplished this year with all of your help.

WCA competitions were introduced to eight new countries and there were over 27,750 new people who competed officially for the first time. This year, our competitors broke barriers and achieved 61 world records, 205 continental records, and 3,760 national records. 
<!-- break -->
On the organizational side, the WCA continued to evolve and make changes to benefit our staff and competitors. The WCA Data Protection Committee and WCA Executive Assistant Team were created to address the implications of the GDPR and to assist the WCA Board with their administrative tasks. Regional Delegate positions were developed to help senior delegates better manage large areas. The [WCA Competition Requirements Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) was implemented to standardize our competitions and the [WCA Equipment Funding Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Equipment%20Funding.pdf) was put in place to offer equipment to Delegates and Regional Organizations in communities where their own investment is hindered by financial or other hardship.

Within our Committees and Teams, there have been 21 investigations taken by the WCA Ethics Committee, more than 1,300 competitions announced by the WCA Competition Announcement Team (with an average announcement time of 21 hours from confirmation) and results for those competitions posted by the WCA Results Team (with an average delay of only 10 hours between submission and upload), and 153 posts made on Facebook and 115 posts on Instagram by the WCA Communication Team. We also appointed 43 new delegates this year!

This was the first year that the WCA collaborated with Red Bull Mind Gamers to have joint events in Spain, China, and Mexico and bring many WCA competitors to the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup 2019 in Russia. The WCA has also began collaborating with Guinness World Records to formally recognize WCA World Records on their website and in their books. Rubik’s made WCA World Championship 2019 possible and we are thankful for their continued support. We look forward to furthering our relationships with these organizations and others into 2020!

After the success of WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne, we are looking forward to coming together for the Asian, European, and North American Championships in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Almere, Netherlands; and Toronto, Canada respectively. We could not achieve any of our goals or developments without the continued support of all who give their time to the WCA in a staff position or by organizing and competing in their communities. Thank you again for another year of success and may you have a wonderful new year!

translation.title: 2019 年年终寄语
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

2019 年，无论是魔方比赛还是 WCA 的组织发展，都又取得了一年的好成绩！我们想借此机会，与大家分享在你们帮助下取得的一些成果。

WCA 比赛首次进入了八个国家，超过 27,750 人首次参加官方比赛。今年，选手们不断突破，创造了 61 项世界纪录、205 项洲际纪录和 3,760 项国家纪录。

在组织层面，WCA 持续改进，为工作人员和选手提供更好的支持。我们成立了 WCA 数据保护委员会，处理《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）带来的相关事务；也成立了 WCA 董事会助理团队，协助董事会处理行政工作。我们设置了地区代表职位，帮助高级代表更好地管理幅员较大的地区。[《WCA 比赛要求政策》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)开始实施，以统一比赛标准；[《WCA 器材资助政策》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Equipment%20Funding.pdf)也已推出，为因经济或其他困难而无法自行购置器材的社区代表和地区组织提供器材。

各委员会和团队同样完成了大量工作：WCA 道德委员会开展了 21 次调查；WCA 比赛公示组公布了超过 1,300 场比赛，从确认到公布平均用时 21 小时；WCA 成绩组发布了这些比赛的成绩，从提交到上传平均仅需 10 小时；WCA 通讯组在 Facebook 发布了 153 条内容，在 Instagram 发布了 115 条内容。今年我们还任命了 43 名新代表！

今年是 WCA 首次与 Red Bull Mind Gamers 合作，在西班牙、中国和墨西哥联合办赛，并让多位 WCA 选手参加了在俄罗斯举行的 2019 红牛魔方世界杯。WCA 也开始与吉尼斯世界纪录合作，让 WCA 世界纪录在吉尼斯官网和书籍中得到正式认可。Rubik’s 的支持让 2019 WCA 世锦赛得以举行，我们感谢他们持续以来的帮助。期待 2020 年继续深化与这些组织及其他伙伴的合作！

2019 WCA 世锦赛在墨尔本成功举办后，我们期待在马来西亚吉隆坡、荷兰阿尔梅勒和加拿大多伦多，分别与大家相聚于亚洲、欧洲和北美锦标赛。无论是在 WCA 任职，还是在自己的社区组织和参加比赛，每一位持续投入时间的人都支持着我们的目标与发展。感谢大家共同成就了这一年，祝你新年愉快！
